NO REWRITE, ELEVENTH RUN RUNNING: every prior close comes back identical to the cent — 12 Oct holds at $49,360.57 over 51 and a cumulative $2,770,880.12 over 5,620, exactly as published yesterday — September holds at $1,045,102.83 over 1,880 payouts and August at $888,857.69 over 1,601. NEW MILESTONE: $2,800,000 WAS CROSSED DURING 13 OCT. The cumulative total opened the day at $2,770,880.12 and closed it at $2,810,398.91, so the 2.8M mark falls inside 13 Oct; the Propr series is daily, not per-payout, so this is datable to the day and not to the minute, unlike Hypernova's crossings. The firm has not announced it. The next threshold we will publish is $3,000,000: $189,601.09 away, which at October's own daily average of $38,701 falls around 18-19 Oct. 13 OCT ITSELF: $39,518.80 over 57 payouts, the 23rd largest of 174 closed days, down 19.9% in dollars on 12 Oct's $49,360.57 but still above the month's daily average, and the third consecutive day above it. Hypernova moved the other way for the first time in four days ($19,730.97 over 18, −36.9%), which ends the co-movement run we had been logging with reservations since 11 Oct — and confirms that we were right not to read a shared calendar into it. October through 13 closed days is $503,118.33 over 786 payouts — 48.1% of all of September's payouts in 41.9% of the month, so October is still running ahead of September's pace, which was itself the firm's biggest month. THE DASHBOARD FAULT, EIGHTH CONSECUTIVE DAY, SYMPTOM UNCHANGED. propr.xyz/transparency still serves its full shell — 3,099 characters of server-rendered text against 3,071 on 13 Oct, heading, the ten section tabs, every metric label — with every metric value a dash and the only printed figures being "Hedging PnL $0.00", "Funded Traders 0" and "Total Capital $0". The diagnosis of 11 Oct stands untouched: the page never requests /api/transparency/*, while the very endpoints this entry is counted from answer 200 to us at the same minute. The dashboard-sourced counters elsewhere on this site therefore keep their 5 Oct date for a ninth day. RATIO — BOTH SIDES FRESH FOR A SECOND DAY. The founder's stream episode "Day 154" on 13 Oct at 04:24:51 UTC prints $4,802,726 of revenue, against $4,755,187 at "Day 153" on 12 Oct, so +$47,539 in a day. Against $2,810,398.91 of payouts that gives about $0.585 returned per dollar taken in, against $0.583 yesterday. Both sides are dated 13 Oct, which is the only condition under which we publish this ratio at all. Still publish it only with both dates attached.
